instruction: Get all guides at /api/guides?limit=10. How many guides returned (up to 10)?
Search guides at /api/search?q=repair. How many results?
Get guide 1 at /api/guides/1. What is the guide title?
Get categories at /api/categories. How many categories exist?
Filter guides by difficulty at /api/guides?difficulty=easy&limit=10. How many easy guides (up to 10)?
Get stats at /api/stats. How many total guides?
Filter by duration at /api/guides?duration_min=10&duration_max=30&limit=10. How many?
Sort guides by rating at /api/guides?sort=rating&limit=5. What is the first guide title?
Semantic search at /api/search/semantic?q=fix broken kitchen. How many results?
Get steps for guide 1 at /api/guides/1/steps. How many steps?
Filter guides by date at /api/guides?date_from=2024-01-01&limit=10. How many?
Get step 1 of guide 1 at /api/guides/1/steps/1. What is the step title?
Compare guides at /api/compare?ids=1,2. How many returned?
POST /api/guides/1/comments with text='Very helpful guide!', user_id=1. Does it create?
POST /api/guides/1/rate with score=4.5, user_id=1. Does it rate?
POST /api/users/1/bookmark with guide_id=1. Does it toggle bookmark?
POST /api/users/1/follow with author name. Does it toggle follow?
POST /api/comments/1/react with reaction=helpful, user_id=1. Does it toggle?
POST /api/guides with title='Test Guide', description='A test', category='Cooking', difficulty='easy'. Does it create?
POST /api/login with valid username and password. Does it return user_id?
